description:
**About The Role**
We're looking for a hands-on Java Developer with 4–5 years of experience who combines solid engineering fundamentals with sharp problem-solving instincts. You'll design and build scalable backend systems, write clean and maintainable code, and work fluidly with modern AI-assisted development tools to ship quality software fast.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust, high-performance backend applications in Java.
* Contribute to architecture decisions — service design, data modeling, API contracts, and scalability trade-offs.
* Design, build, and operate microservices, including inter-service communication, resilience, and deployment.
* Instrument services for observability — logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting — to ensure reliability in production.
* Write clean, well-tested, production-grade code and participate in code reviews.
* Leverage AI-assisted / "vibe coding" tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to prototype and deliver features efficiently, while maintaining full ownership and understanding of the output.
* Debug complex issues across the stack and reason through ambiguous problems independently.
* Collaborate with product, QA, and DevOps to deliver end-to-end features.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4–5 years of professional Java development experience.
* Strong grasp of core Java, OOP, collections, concurrency, and the JVM.
* Solid experience with Spring / Spring Boot and building RESTful APIs.
* Architecture: Proven ability to design scalable, maintainable systems; understanding of microservices, design patterns, and system design principles.
* Microservices: Hands-on experience building and running microservices — service decomposition, REST/gRPC communication, API gateways, and resilience patterns (circuit breakers, retries).
* Observability: Practical experience with logging, metrics, and distributed tracing using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or similar.
* Coding: Clean-code discipline, strong testing habits (JUnit/Mockito), and Git-based workflows.
* Vibe coding: Comfortable and productive with AI-assisted coding tools; able to prompt, review, and refine AI-generated code rather than blindly accept it.
* Analytical ability (high IQ): Excellent logical reasoning and problem-solving skills; able to break down complex problems and learn new concepts quickly.
* Experience with SQL and at least one relational database.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure) and CI/CD pipelines.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and caching (Redis).
* Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Exposure to event-driven or distributed systems at scale.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of meaningful, high-impact work.
* A modern, AI-forward engineering culture.

**Benefits**
We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:
  
  

* Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage
* Excellent rewards and recognition policy
* Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC
* Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year
* Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.
* Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events
* Quarterly Coffee with CEO
* and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours:**
Ginesys is India’s best omniretail suite, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online and offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 300+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite.
  
  
We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.
  
  
Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in

title: Senior Software Engineer Rust- Assistant Vice President
description:
**Department Overview**
The
**Equities Technology**
division is responsible for building and maintaining the high-performance, ultra-low-latency trading infrastructure that powers our global equities business. This includes market data dissemination, order routing, algorithmic execution, smart order routing (SOR), and real-time risk management systems. We operate in a highly competitive environment where microseconds matter, requiring cutting-edge software engineering practices, deep hardware-software co-design, and robust system reliability.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an exceptional
**Senior Software Engineer**
with deep expertise in
**Rust**
and
**C++**
to join our Equities Low-Latency Trading Technology team.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize our next-generation trading systems. You will lead the strategic transition of legacy high-performance C++ components to modern Rust where safety and concurrency are paramount, while continuing to maintain and optimize critical ultra-low-latency C++ execution paths. This is a highly technical role requiring a strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, network protocols, and modern software engineering paradigms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Skills**
**8+ YOE is a must have**

* System Design & Development
* Architect, build, and maintain ultra-low-latency trading systems, including exchange connectivity gateways, market data feeds, and algorithmic execution engines using Rust and C++
* Design clean, modular, and reusable APIs and libraries that can be leveraged across multiple trading desks.
* Lead the strategic migration of critical trading components from C++ to Rust, leveraging Rust's memory safety and concurrency guarantees without sacrificing performance.
* Performance Optimization
* Profile and optimize systems to achieve sub-microsecond latencies and deterministic performance.
* Apply low-latency techniques such as CPU pinning, cache-friendly data structures, lock-free programming, memory-mapped files, and custom memory allocators.
* Utilize kernel bypass technologies (e.g., Solarflare OpenOnload, DPDK, EF\\_VI) to minimize network stack overhead.
* Concurrency & Reliability
* Design and implement highly concurrent, thread-safe, and lock-free algorithms to handle massive throughput with minimal jitter.
* Implement rigorous testing methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, property-based testing (in Rust), and high-fidelity simulation/back testing environments.
* Ensure the high availability and operational resilience of trading systems through robust error handling and failover mechanisms.
* Collaboration & Support
* Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and product managers to translate complex trading strategies and business requirements into robust, production-ready software.
* Build real-time telemetry, monitoring, and alerting tools to ensure operational visibility.
* Provide level-3 escalation support for production systems during market hours.

**Required Technical Skills & Qualifications**
**Programming Languages**

* C++: Expert-level proficiency in C++ (C++11/14/17/20), with a deep understanding of template metaprogramming, RAII, move semantics, smart pointers, and the standard library (STL).
* Rust: Strong proficiency in Rust, including ownership/borrowing concepts, lifetimes, unsafe Rust boundaries, macro systems, and the Cargo ecosystem.

**Systems Programming & Low-Latency**

* Deep understanding of Linux operating system internals (kernel tuning, memory management, virtual memory, page faults, system calls).
* Experience with low-latency networking (TCP/IP, UDP, Multicast) and socket programming.
* Familiarity with hardware-level concepts: CPU cache hierarchies (L1/L2/L3), TLB, branch prediction, and memory barriers.

**Concurrency**

* Proven experience in multi-threaded programming, memory models (sequential consistency, acquire-release), and lock-free data structures.

**Equities Domain Knowledge**

* Solid understanding of Equities market structure, order types, exchange protocols (FIX, OUCH, ITCH), and trading lifecycles.

**Tools & Infrastructure**

* Experience with profiling and debugging tools (gdb, valgrind, perf, VTune, heaptrack).
* Proficiency with build systems (CMake, Cargo) and CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with FPGA integration or hardware acceleration.
* Experience with kernel bypass technologies (Solarflare EF\\_VI, OpenOnload, DPDK).
* Knowledge of market-making, smart order routing (SOR), or statistical arbitrage execution strategies.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

**Core Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex systems and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment.
* Adaptability: Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving business requirements and market conditions.
* Quality Focus: Commitment to writing clean, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
AI Security Consultant, Infrastructure
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
* Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 2+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains.
* Hands-on experience designing, integrating and securing production generative AI, RAG or agentic workloads, including model, tool and enterprise data connections.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, with working knowledge of infrastructure security patterns in the other major cloud platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and securing cloud and network infrastructure, Kubernetes or container platforms, and production AI or model-serving workloads.
* Strong knowledge of network segmentation, private connectivity, egress controls, DNS, TLS, firewalls, gateways, service meshes and enterprise integration patterns.
* Implementation experience with Terraform or comparable IaC, CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, Kubernetes RBAC, network policies, admission controls and secrets.
* Ability to design, build and review infrastructure automation using Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell or a comparable language, together with HCL or YAML, Git and CI/CD tooling.
* Ability to travel 25% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and engagements you serve.

Preferred:
  
  

* Previous consulting, client delivery or customer-facing engineering experience.
* Experience across both managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
* Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices or AI-specific monitoring.
* Experience developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers or contributing to engineering standards.
* Familiarity with the broader machine learning lifecycle and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or MLflow.
* Experience with AI platforms and model-serving technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore or SageMaker AI; Microsoft Foundry or Azure Machine Learning; Google Vertex AI; vLLM; KServe; NVIDIA Triton or NIM; Ray Serve; or comparable platforms.
* Experience securing GPU infrastructure, model and container registries, software supply chains, signed artifacts, service meshes or multi-tenant inference environments.

CCH Tagetik Senior Analyst – Consolidation, Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Senior Analyst, you will support the design, configuration, implementation, testing, and ongoing enhancement of CCH Tagetik solutions across Financial Consolidation and Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to translate requirements into practical application solutions, support data integration and reporting, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to reliable project and production delivery. The role requires a strong understanding of finance processes, attention to data quality, and a commitment to building deeper functional and technical expertise in CCH Tagetik.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
Support end-to-end implementation and enhancement of CCH Tagetik Financial Consolidation and Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting solutions.
  
  
Work with business stakeholders to understand requirements, document functional specifications, and translate them into scalable Tagetik configurations.
  
  
Configure and maintain dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, forms, reports, processes, rules, and calculation logic.
  
  
Support consolidation activities, including data collection, currency translation, intercompany matching and elimination, journals, ownership structures, validation controls, and period-end processes.
  
  
Support planning and forecasting activities, including driver-based planning, allocations, scenario and version management, workflow execution, and management reporting.
  
  
Assist with data integration, mapping, reconciliation, validation, and issue resolution across source systems and CCH Tagetik.
  
  
Prepare and execute unit testing, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, regression testing, and deployment activities.
  
  
Investigate functional and technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, and coordinate timely resolution with relevant teams.
  
  
Create and maintain solution documentation, configuration guides, test evidence, knowledge assets, and user training materials.
  
  
Contribute to production support, release activities, continuous improvement, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Must have: Hands-on experience with CCH Tagetik Consolidation and/or Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting.
  
  
Good understanding of financial consolidation concepts, including legal and management consolidation, currency translation, intercompany elimination, journals, ownership, validation, and financial reporting.
  
  
Good understanding of FP&A processes, including annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario planning, driver-based planning, allocations, and variance analysis.
  
  
Experience configuring Tagetik dimensions, hierarchies, workflows, forms, reports, process controls, and business rules.
  
  
Experience with data loading, transformation, mapping, reconciliation, validation, testing, and troubleshooting.
  
  
Basic understanding of ERP and financial-system integrations, relational data concepts, and reporting requirements.
  
  
Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
  
  
Ability to work collaboratively, manage assigned deliverables, and support project and production timelines.
  
  
Additional Information:
  
  
Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in CCH Tagetik Consolidation and/or Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting.
  
  
A full-time education of 15 years is required.
  
  
Relevant CCH Tagetik certification or implementation experience will be an advantage.
  
  
Candidates should be comfortable working in project delivery and application support environments.
